annotations.title: Fact-check an insider-buying claim against SEC Form 4

description: Use when the user wants to verify or fact-check a claim that an insider bought a stock, or to pull the purchases in one filing by accession. Pass the claim (ticker/issuer, person, amount, timeframe), or pass `accession` alone to fetch that filing's gated purchase records. Returns confirmed (with source filing + link), not_found, partial (itemised claimed-vs-filed), out_of_scope (sales/options/grants), or out_of_coverage. Caveat: filing-verified — absence is reported as absence, never estimated or guessed.

accession.description: SEC filing accession, e.g. 0001493152-26-040454. If you already have the exact filing, pass this to pull its gated purchase records directly — it is used alone and ignores the claim fields above.

amount_usd.description: Claimed purchase value in USD (matched ±5% or ±$1)

date.description: Claimed date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (matched ±3 filing days)

end.description: Window end (ISO) if the claim is a range

issuer_name.description: Issuer/company name (use if you don't have the ticker)

person.description: Insider name in any order, e.g. 'Alfonso de Angoitia'

start.description: Window start (ISO) if the claim is a range

txn_type.description: Optional; only open-market buys are covered — sale/option/grant returns out_of_scope

name: verify_insider_purchase
title: Fact-check an insider-buying claim against SEC Form 4
